info.title: x402.wtf Omni Facilitator
info.description: Non-custodial omni-chain x402 facilitator hub. Verify and settle exact-scheme payments on Solana mainnet and devnet, Base, Bitcoin, Lightning, Cardano and NEAR Intents, with x402m batch settlement, receipts and z402 prepaid vouchers. Facilitator endpoints are free; resource servers set their own prices.

get.description: Returns the x402m discovery document: facilitator id, operator, schemes, networks, extensions and the full endpoint map.
Returns every (x402Version, scheme, network) kind this facilitator can verify and settle, plus supported extensions.

200.description: Supported kinds document: { kinds: [{ x402Version, scheme, network, extra? }], extensions: [] }.

post.summary: Verify a payment payload without settling
post.description: Checks a payer-signed payment payload against its payment requirements and returns a verdict. Verification is read-only: nothing is submitted on chain.

paymentPayload.description: The payer-signed x402 payment payload (v1 X-PAYMENT body or v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE envelope contents).

paymentRequirements.description: The payment requirements the payload claims to satisfy: scheme, network (CAIP-2), asset, payTo, maxAmountRequired.

200.description: Verdict JSON: { isValid: boolean, invalidReason?: string, payer?: string }.

post.summary: Submit a verified payment payload for settlement
post.description: Submits or completes the payment described by the payload and returns the settlement result. A payment redeems exactly once; replays are rejected.

paymentPayload.description: The payer-signed x402 payment payload (v1 X-PAYMENT body or v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE envelope contents).

paymentRequirements.description: The payment requirements the payload claims to satisfy: scheme, network (CAIP-2), asset, payTo, maxAmountRequired.

200.description: Settlement result JSON: { success: true, transaction: string, network: string, payer: string }.

400.description: Settlement failed or payload invalid: { success: false, error: string, errorReason?: string }.

get.description: Returns { status: 'ok', service: 'x402-wtf', facilitator: 'x402wtf' } when the hub is up.
Returns the catalog of 215 pay-per-call tools served from this host (name, price, rails). Tool execution is metered per call; see POST /v1/tools/pumpai_get_health for the gated call shape.

200.description: Tool catalog JSON: { data: { count: 215, tools: [...] } }.

post.description: Executes one call of the pumpai_get_health tool. Every tool in the catalog is called the same way at the same flat price: POST /v1/tools/<name>. Unpaid calls return an x402 challenge priced at $0.01 in USDC on Solana mainnet (Base USDC also accepted), settled through this facilitator; the tool executes once per payment.

200.description: Tool result JSON, with the settlement receipt in the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header.

402.description: Payment required — x402 challenge (exact scheme, Solana mainnet or Base, USDC).
